title: Cuppa Cuppa Cuppa Cake
description: A simple and delicious cake inspired by Dolly Parton, featuring a fruit cocktail base.

ingredients.item: tinned fruit cocktail with juice (not syrup)
Plus a few thin slices of butter

steps: Bake at 180C/350F for 20-30 mins until gold & bubbly.
Serve over ice cream to cut the sweet.
notes:
The recipe is quite rich, so serving it over ice cream helps to balance the sweetness.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1HF6LFPPsb/

Nutrition: Serving 1 slice · Calories 280 kcal · Fat 6g · Saturated fat 3g · Unsaturated fat 2g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 15mg · Sodium 150mg · Carbs 55g · Fiber 1g · Sugar 40g · Protein 2g

healthy: Includes some fruit from the fruit cocktail.
Small ingredient list with no frosting.
not_healthy: A full cup of sugar makes it high in added sugar.
Self-raising white flour is refined with little fiber.
